title: •Drop!
caption: •Drop! (V)
game_text: Deploy on table with 12 Defensive Shields from outside your deck face-down under here. Four times per game may play a card from here (as if from hand). Unless {ovs} Thrown Back on table, each player’s ▲ or ▼ attempt (after the first in a turn) allows their opponent to draw top card from Reserve deck and/or activate 1 Force.
lore: Anakin had to heed Qui-Gon’s advice to avoid the rapidly approaching storm.

notes: Unique. Banner STARTING EFFECT (printed base is a plain Effect), no grabber box. Inline icon in 'Unless [icon] Thrown Back on table': the orange VS8 set sphere itself → {ovs} (i.e. Thrown Back (V), VS8 #21); the stub drops it. Slip prints ▲ / ▼ where the stub expands 'Take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle' / 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'. Curly apostrophe in player’s. 'Reserve deck' lowercase 'd' as printed. No comma after 'Four times per game' as printed. Lore corrected from scan: curly apostrophe in Qui-Gon’s (wiki straight). Coruscant base: the scan shows a second small round icon (a '+'-like mark) under the expansion ring beside the lore box — part of the printed Coruscant frame, not transcribed. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright = Coruscant 2001 SE-style line (run default, as vs5/19), not legible at 350 px. Modern: Virtual Block 6 only (VB6 -pre, 350 px). Art: printed scan by its measured Episode I window (art.rect; the old trim zoomed in — Bill 2026-10-14).
